name: Taming the Beast
label: Quest
description: In Bloodhoof Village, Yaw Sharpmane sets a young tauren hunter a new trial. The hunter must master the swift prairie stalker.

clips.title: The story
paras: In Bloodhoof Village, Yaw Sharpmane sets a young tauren hunter a new trial. The hunter must master the swift prairie stalker.

After mastering the adult plainstrider’s endurance, you face a different kind of hunter. Prairie stalkers rely on speed, move in packs, and attack without fear. To tame one, you must approach this cunning predator without breaking stride, matching the wolf’s decisive nature.

Yaw Sharpmane teaches you that hunting beside a beast means neither servitude nor brute force. You and the predator must fight as one, joined by respect and shared rhythm. Bonding with a prairie stalker under Mulgore’s open skies teaches you to complement your companion’s attacks and move with it in battle.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have a fiery spirit, hunter, readily awaiting your next challenge.
Your next task is to gain the companionship of a wolf known as the prairie stalker. This creature is swift and fearless; in taking this beast as your pet, you must also take on these qualities.
During a battle, you will learn how you and your pet will become a team. In the end you must work as one, muscle to muscle.
Here is the taming rod, friend. Tame a prairie stalker and practice your skills.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you found a prairie stalker?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes... The Earthmother believes that you are ready for the next lesson.
